note: Shared excursion fixtures. Offsets are seconds from a common epoch; temperatures are °C. The device (logic.excursion.detect_excursions) and the server engine (milestone 10) must both reproduce the 'expected' excursions from each 'series'.

cases.name: steady_normal
cases.description: Always inside the band: no excursion.

cases.name: short_spike_no_alert
cases.description: A door opening: out of range for less than dwell, then back. No alarm.

cases.name: sustained_high
cases.description: Out of range past dwell, then recovers past recovery: one closed HIGH excursion.

cases.name: sustained_low
cases.description: Below the band past dwell, then recovers: one closed LOW excursion.

cases.name: flapping_stays_one_excursion
cases.description: Briefly back in range (< recovery) does not clear: still one excursion.

cases.name: open_at_end
cases.description: Series ends while still in excursion: one open excursion (ended_offset null).
